name: choice-poll
blurb: Composable poll component with single/multi-select, results display, and vote tracking.
description: Flexible poll/voting component built with composable sub-components. Supports single or multiple selections, result visualization with progress bars, percentage displays, and vote tracking. Controlled or uncontrolled modes via context.
use_when: Building in-page polls, surveys, or voting interfaces with result visualization.
avoid_when: Simple radio button groups or checkboxes where full poll features aren't needed.
a11y: Built on semantic button elements with keyboard navigation. Context-driven for proper labeling. Check mark icon for visual feedback.
